name: qa
description: QA separated from dev: acceptance criteria with a usage oracle, scenario design with ISTQB techniques, automation with existing tools (Gherkin, Hurl, Testcontainers, Toxiproxy, Pact, Schemathesis, Playwright), verification by rungs with traceability and an integrity seal, failure classification and bug injection to test the tests. The implementing agent never writes the oracle and QA never certifies.
